newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Telekom changes name of MRCB Telecom.
newsitem.headline: Telekom changes name of MRCB Telecom.

text.p: Telekom Malaysia Bhd said on Monday it was changing the name of recently-acquired MRCB Telecommunications Sdn Bhd to Telekom Cellular Sdn Bhd.
It said in a press invitation note that its chief executive, Mohamed Said Mohamed Ali, will launch Telekom Cellular's service line logo, TMTOUCH on Tuesday.
Telekom bought MRCB Telecom for 640 million ringgit in June this year as part of government efforts then to reduce the number of players in the overcrowded telecommunications industry.
MRCB Telecom was the cellular telecommunications arm of Malaysian Resources Corp Bhd (MRCB), which has since focused mainly on property and construction activities.
Telekom has previously said it plans to invest 500 million ringgit in MRCB Telecom over the next three years to expand and improve the cellular network of its subsidiary.
